source_basis: Classical prerequisites and elementary worked calculations; no new programme theorem or scientific adoption.

sources.actual_reading: Complete primary text excerpts: 0.14–0.15;3.1.1–3.1.2;3.3.1–3.3.3;3.4.2–3.4.12;3.5.8–3.5.15. Printed pages8–9,157–158,165–166,174–184,197–200. Additional lines adjacent to excerpts were read, without a claim of full-book reading.
sources.proof_reading_limits: For the factorization equivalence the complete printed proof3.4.10–12 was read; its earlier general D-module prerequisites are used as standard background, not reread in full.

claims.4.1-4.4: BD3.1.1–2: precise opens, operation spaces and composition domains.
claims.4.5: Elementary residue derivative formula, tested with a missing-factorial mutation.
claims.4.6: BD3.5.9–15: full OPE and classical chiral-Lie correspondence, not an identification with ordered associative duality.
claims.4.7-4.8 and theorem: BD3.4.2–12: ordinary sheaf conditions, compatible unit/factorization, canonical connection, full equivalence and its Chevalley–Cousin proof mechanism.
claims.collision support example: Ordinary sheaf restriction, kernel and cokernel example; the derived localization triangle is deferred to chapter05 to preserve definition order.
claims.4.9-4.10: Elementary three-point set calculation for consecutive-cut domains, compared with the existing chapter05 geometry; finite check detects replacement by small diagonal.

narrow_review_repairs: Diagonal map described as inserting repeated coordinates rather than collapsing in the arrow direction.
Derived localization paragraph deferred to chapter05; ordinary support example retained; subsequent equation numbers adjusted.
